statements: VC-27.7: "every ManagementApiClient endpoint shares one Result contract - NetworkError on transport failure, ApiError(body,status) on non-2xx, DeserializationError on a bad body ... health_check (:586-597) is the one exception"
reason: The poll now joins three calls, including get_chain_payments, and ProcessAgentStatuses carries a new dids field. A separate ProcessChainPayments message is sent after it. get_chain_payments also returns Ok(None) on a 404, so health_check is no longer the only endpoint outside the shared error contract.
